_comment: Mutant catalogue for the imp test-hardening audit.
Each entry injects ONE semantically meaningful fault drawn from a real bug
class in LLM-inference engines — not arithmetic noise. `find` must match
exactly once in `file`; run.py refuses the mutant otherwise, so a source
edit that de-uniquifies an anchor fails loudly instead of mutating the
wrong site. `focus` names the test binary most likely to catch it (run
first, purely a speed optimisation — survival is only declared after the

mutants.desc: Causal mask off by one: a query may attend to the key one position in its future.
mutants.find:
if (causal && gq < gk)
                val = -FLT_MAX;
mutants.replace:
if (causal && gq < gk - 1)
                val = -FLT_MAX;

mutants.desc: Sliding-window boundary flipped from exclusive to inclusive (one extra token in window).
mutants.find: if (sliding_window > 0 && (gq - gk) >= sliding_window)
mutants.replace: if (sliding_window > 0 && (gq - gk) > sliding_window)

mutants.desc: Out-of-range score tile entries are left unmasked instead of set to -inf (padding leakage).
Drop the 1/sqrt(d) attention scale in the WMMA prefill score path.
mutants.find: float val = S_tile[i] * scale;
mutants.replace: float val = S_tile[i];

mutants.desc: Apply the attention scale twice in the WMMA prefill score path.
mutants.find:

mutants.replace:
float val = S_tile[i] * scale * scale;
            if (softcap > 0.0f)

mutants.desc: Causal KV-tile bound drops the last tile: queries never see the newest keys.
mutants.find: int furthest_kv_tile = (max_q_global + Bc) / Bc;
mutants.replace: int furthest_kv_tile = max_q_global / Bc;

mutants.desc: Sliding-window first-tile bound rounds the wrong way, skipping one KV tile.
mutants.find: int earliest_kv = q_offset + q_start - sliding_window + 1;
mutants.replace: int earliest_kv = q_offset + q_start - sliding_window + 1 + Bc;

mutants.desc: StreamingLLM window start off by one block: the oldest window token is dropped.
mutants.find: r.window_start_block = window_start / block_size;
mutants.replace: r.window_start_block = window_start / block_size + 1;

mutants.desc: Sink region clamp uses <= so one non-sink token leaks into the sink range.

GQA paged decode: drop the QK scale before softmax.
mutants.replace:

                dot = apply_softcap(dot, softcap);

mutants.desc: Paged decode reads the block table of the next sequence in the batch (page-table off-by-one).
GQA paged decode: KV block stride computed without the head dimension (wrong stride).
mutants.find:
const int* bt = block_tables + (int64_t)batch_idx * max_num_blocks;
    const int kv_block_stride = block_size * n_kv_heads * head_dim;
mutants.replace:

    const int kv_block_stride = block_size * n_kv_heads;

mutants.desc: Drop the __syncthreads() guarding shared-memory reuse between pipelined KV loads.
mutants.find: __syncthreads();  // guard smem reuse from pipelined loads
mutants.replace: // __syncthreads();  // guard smem reuse from pipelined loads [MUTANT: removed]

mutants.desc: Drop the __syncthreads() between the next-block load and the current-block compute.

mutants.replace: // __syncthreads();  [MUTANT: removed] next-block load / current compute

mutants.desc: RoPE base frequency uses 2*theta: every rotary angle is wrong.
mutants.find: float freq = 1.0f / powf(theta, (2.0f * pair_idx) / static_cast<float>(2 * rope_pairs));
mutants.replace: float freq = 1.0f / powf(theta * 2.0f, (2.0f * pair_idx) / static_cast<float>(2 * rope_pairs));

mutants.desc: NeoX rotary pairs the wrong half of the head dim (pair_idx + rope_pairs/2).
mutants.find: const int idx1 = neox ? (pair_idx + rope_pairs) : (2 * pair_idx + 1);
mutants.replace: const int idx1 = neox ? (pair_idx + rope_pairs / 2) : (2 * pair_idx + 1);

mutants.desc: Rotation applied to Q but not K (K is stored unrotated).
Position offset off by one for every token (cached tokens rotate to the wrong slot).
mutants.find:
if (!m.positions)
        return fallback + (m.pos_delta ? m.pos_delta[token_idx] : 0);
mutants.replace:

        return fallback + 1 + (m.pos_delta ? m.pos_delta[token_idx] : 0);

mutants.desc: Multiblock sampler ignores top_p entirely (nucleus filter never truncates).
CUB sampler path ignores top_p (nucleus filter never truncates).
temperature<=0 no longer routes to greedy in the batched decode path (deterministic request becomes stochastic).
mutants.find: const bool greedy = (state.temperature <= 0.0f || state.top_k == 1);
mutants.replace: const bool greedy = (state.top_k == 1);

mutants.desc: Q4_K nibble order swapped (high/low nibble selection inverted).
Q4_K dequant drops the block minimum (zero-point), leaving only the scale term.
mutants.find: float val = d * static_cast<float>(sc_val) * static_cast<float>(q4) - dmin * static_cast<float>(min_val);
mutants.replace: float val = d * static_cast<float>(sc_val) * static_cast<float>(q4);

mutants.desc: Q5_K dequant swaps the scale and the zero-point terms.
mutants.find: float val = d * static_cast<float>(sc_val) * static_cast<float>(q5) - dmin * static_cast<float>(min_val);
mutants.replace: float val = dmin * static_cast<float>(sc_val) * static_cast<float>(q5) - d * static_cast<float>(min_val);

mutants.desc: Split-K partial merge drops the per-split rescale weight (wrong cross-split softmax).
Online softmax skips the running-max rescale, so long contexts overflow instead of staying stable.
mutants.find:

    float exp_diff = expf(m_w - m_new);

mutants.desc: Softcap applied without the tanh (linear clamp instead of the model's saturating cap).
mutants.find: return (softcap > 0.0f) ? (softcap * tanhf(dot / softcap)) : dot;
mutants.replace: return (softcap > 0.0f) ? dot : dot;
